purpose: Teach: 取りまとめ/ファックス/激励/主査/次官/母体/個室/衣服

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のデータの取りまとめを任せる
lines.en: Ren, I'm entrusting you with compiling the lab data.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Slight pause before the name — settling responsibility. Quiet confidence in the assignment. Voice drops slightly at the end, landing the trust without fanfare.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古い文献のファックス資料も整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the old literature and fax materials too.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Quick, efficient acceptance. Slight emphasis on the thoroughness — showing he's thinking beyond the bare assignment. Steady, eager to prove capable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、後輩への激励の言葉も大事にしろ
lines.en: Ren, remember — encouraging the junior members matters just as much.
lines.style: Warm shift in tone. Not lecturing but investing in the next point. Slight lift at the end, like he's placing something important in Ren's hands alongside the task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の主査と相談しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm already coordinating with the lab director on that.
lines.style: Quiet reassurance. Quick breath before speaking — showing he's ahead on this. Respectful but not defensive. Shows he's thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、業界の元次官の話を聞く機会も活かせ
lines.en: Ren, make sure you use the opportunity to hear from that former government official in the industry.
lines.style: Deliberate, opening with weight. Slight emphasis on 「use」 — this is a resource. Measured pace. The tone of someone opening a door and expecting Ren to walk through it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究機関の母体組織を分析します
lines.en: Yes. I'll analyze the parent organization of the research institution.
lines.style: Focused, methodical response. Quick intake of breath before starting — showing mental shift to the next task. Steady, almost contemplative pace. Demonstrating he's taking it seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、面談用の個室を確保しろ
lines.en: Ren, secure a private room for the interviews.
lines.style: Clipped, direct instruction. Brief weight on 「secure」. No extra words — this is practical. The tone of someone who expects it done and moves on.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。発表の際は衣服にも気を配ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll pay attention to my appearance for the presentation as well.
lines.style: Thoughtful closing. Steady exhale before speaking. Slightly slower pace — showing he's absorbed all the instructions and is integrating each detail. Quiet, sincere commitment.
